mechanism: Both agents have potential nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity; amikacin is aminoglycoside with renal excretion risk, emtricitabine requires renal clearance and may accumulate with renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) regularly; adjust amikacin dosing based on renal function; ensure adequate hydration; monitor for hearing loss and vestibular effects.
